title: BBZ Normalized Provider Alarm Event
description: .ai/INTEGRATIONS_CODA_VIDEO.md `Alarm normalization` — the immutable, vendor-neutral form every inbound technical/panic alarm is normalized to BEFORE trigger evaluation (E16-04). Persisted once in the E04-07 provider inbox and deduplicated (ADR-0006). The raw vendor payload is NEVER stored here — only its SHA-256 in raw_hash. additionalProperties:false at every level so a vendor field is a rejection, not a silent pass.

provider_event_id.description: the provider's stable event id, or a deterministic id derived from documented stable fields (prefixed derived:) when the provider has none

provider_alarm_id.description: the provider's alarm-object id when it differs from provider_event_id

alarm_subtype.description: normalized subtype, e.g. panic_button; vendor names are mapped in provider config

severity_external.description: the provider's own severity string, unmapped — the BBZ priority is decided by admin config (E16-06), not here

associated_camera_ids.description: normalized camera handles the provider links to this alarm — no vendor object ids

raw_hash.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the canonical raw vendor payload — the payload itself is kept only in provider-side diagnostics, never here
